scope: prospective independent physical-source synthetic text/image confirmation of content-control and NDU contributions under complete budgets
r1_policy: sealed forever; no retraining, tuning or re-evaluation against r1 held-out
candidate_execution_order: nine seed/LR candidate rounds per arm; four systems rotated by round index; only active per-system CPU attributed
selected_validation_order: three seed rounds; four systems rotated by seed index; full only, no critic or random policy
formal_measurement_order: three seed rounds; four systems rotated by seed index; exactly one full service measurement per arm/seed
cpu_failure_policy: after each phase, preserve partial ledger and stop further work immediately if actual complete per-system CPU exceeds the unchanged cap
diagnostic_telemetry: phase CPU/wall/main-thread CPU, rusage, process threads, bounded GC pauses and read-only container counter deltas; once-per-build same-process NumPy/loaded BLAS version, path/hash, actual threadpool, affinity, trace/profile and configured thread environment captured inside charged shared CPU; observations do not establish a process-level cause
training_allocation_profile: lazy Adam zero moments only at each parameter's first update; unchanged gradient, clipping, arithmetic, RNG and per-parameter clocks
adaptation_kernel_scope: candidate and selected residual training only; shared decoder300 and dense pretraining500 unchanged; existing idx/mask RNG and np.where expanded inputs preserved; each low row checked for exact 2x2 replicas; current encoder folded each step and low gradient expanded back to original 202-dimensional parameters; same real-arithmetic equations with changed floating reduction order
adaptation_work_accounting: pre-draw admission uses a componentwise work envelope, never charged as actual work; actual mask geometry determines the complete atomic step charge; actual objective-step ledger deltas determine CPU/unit forecasts; complete seed rounds admitted before any residual RNG draws
adaptation_optimizer_scope: candidate and selected residual content updates only, all adaptation arms; shared decoder300 and dense pretraining500 retain original NumPy Adam; original gradients, Python norm and clipping, per-parameter clocks and Python power denominators; one no-fast-math, contraction-disabled C pass preserves original element expressions
adaptation_optimizer_accounting: unchanged complete per-step operator inventory; explicit initial parameter/existing-moment finite scans charged and reserved per candidate; allocation, binding, compilation and every dispatch remain inside actual complete CPU; bitwise handmade update equivalence required, no a priori speed or content benefit
decoder_observation_profile: one locally prepared actual decoded observation/reward per always-full validation; selected scoring shares normal reward/metrics and independently decodes the actual corrupted decoder; no global or output cache
preparation_forecast_rule: retain three actual TRAIN preparation CPU samples per seed/mode; for m future preparations estimate m*median(samples)+max(0,max(samples)-median(samples)); same formula for every arm, not a charge or cap guarantee; all actual work remains fully charged
refinement: after one global LR selection per arm, retain selected optimizer/RNG state; use affordable complete three-seed rounds without validation stopping or reselection; actual objective-step units forecast CPU and componentwise worst inventory admits before any draw
output_sampling_profile: batched inverse-CDF with preserved (n,2) draw ordering, exact left-edge/clamp behavior and batch pixel quantization; actual per-request PNG, hash, base64 and JSON unchanged; declared sampling arithmetic and all-CDF comparisons charged
runtime_profile: fixed batches up to 64 requests; complete batch CPU and latency retained; not a single-request latency qualification
build_cpu_attribution: entire arm build CPU including full common preparation, all three seeds and all nine LR/seed candidates, divided by three selected model seeds; each selected seed serves H=100000 requests
selection: global LR maximizes mean three-seed validation always-full decoded task utility minus the frozen TRAIN full-service CPU price; no mode/critic/threshold search and no residual LR reselection
calibration: same deterministic TRAIN-only source/target-balanced 72-row matching as r2; three full-service repeats per seed, nine measures/648 real outputs; frozen reference is median per-row full CPU of first shared seed
no_padding: only applied objective kernels execute; cached fixed decoder objective and one encoder forward per update; cheaper systems spend savings on extra updates up to the same build caps; static baselines do not fit or run an unused critic
cpu_bootstrap_clusters: fixed 64-request runtime batch cohorts crossed with model seed; raw content metrics retain physical-source clusters; CPU claims are conditional on this frozen batching profile

benefit_gate.combination: intersection-union: all six declared lower bounds >0; no alternative endpoint can substitute

validation_readiness: all A-H and N-A validation means positive for task_utility, joint_success and complete cpu_net_utility; per-seed greedy drop <=0.02 for these two transitions; all12 corruption score drops >0; no complete build or service violations; otherwise nonzero and no test construction
test_policy: one exclusive experiment-wide core-c1 marker and one exclusive selected-run marker before first test construction; never remove after failure; no output-directory bypass, favorable identical-source wave repeat or post-test threshold/source change
retained_prior_results: r1 sealed forever; every r2 failure and original dynamic gate remains unchanged; r2 validation/OOF/timing R&D informed this design but does not qualify core-c1
protocol_status: prospectively registered core-c1-v2 after retained pre-training t1 matching failure; new source freeze required

data_seed_derivation.policy: derive once before constructing any split; do not reject or choose seeds using data or scores

reporting.cpu_ci_scope: fixed 64-request batch cohorts crossed with model seed, conditional on the single frozen execution wave; not a CI over common wave CPU shocks
reporting.test_rows: retain all input bytes or exactly reconstructible frozen tensor artifact, physical IDs/hashes, every seed and per-row metric/cost arrays
reporting.research_cost_policy: separately retain cumulative R&D, failures, diagnostics, evaluation and administrative costs; never budget credits or matched lifetime-cost claim

claims_excluded: NDU superiority to full-strength supervised CE
simultaneous 95-percent coverage of every marginal CI
CPU benefit across unmeasured execution waves
execution_environment: saved hepta-private-ci Codex cloud environment only; no dot workspace, user computer, Actions or denial/quota bypass
artifact_binding: pre-build committed source/protocol/plan/compiler policy; during billed build bind binary/actual environment/train-validation manifests/selected inference artifacts/complete costs; verify actual protocol bytes at training and test preflight; optimizer source/profile and update receipts, no serialized moment/RNG resume claim
calibration_revision: global exact source/target margins and unique physical sources; six deterministic perfect-matching rounds; legacy r2 cyclic joint-cell selection unchanged; no data/seed/margin/budget/statistical-gate change
